europe_now.title: Severe Flooding Impacts Spain
europe_now.summary: Torrential rain has led to significant flooding across parts of Spain, generating widespread visual documentation of the damage. Local authorities are managing the immediate aftermath of the severe weather.

sources.headline: Spain: Images of floods after torrential rain

europe_now.title: Ukraine Conflict and Leadership Changes
europe_now.summary: The ongoing regional conflict continues to see intense battlefield movements as Russian forces target infrastructure and attempt territorial advances. Meanwhile, political adjustments unfold in Kyiv with the appointment of a new chief prosecutor.

top_stories.title: EU Policy and Digital Regulation Initiatives
top_stories.summary: European institutions are pursuing broader policy measures regarding social media age limits and algorithmic controls. These legislative efforts aim to establish stronger regulatory oversight across member states.

sources.headline: EU plans Europe‑wide social media age limits, but can Brussels really police Big Tech?

top_stories.title: Transatlantic Relations and Trade Developments
top_stories.summary: Diplomatic engagement between European entities and Canada continues to deepen through strategic partnerships and high-level visits. At the same time, broader international trade pressures and legislative measures from global partners draw reactions from European officials.
